Had a baby in Jan my memories are still fresh:

Are you breast feeding or formula feeding? If you are on the breast you need a good breast feeding bra, a pump for home, and ice packs for the first few days/weeks.

Steal as many of those snot suckers (balbus seringe is their proper name) as you can get your hands on at the hospital. The ones sold in stores are not as good as hospital grade (just keep "loosing" yours).

Take a handful of their sergical underwear, and then take some more (they had a whole stack in my room and I put it in my bag the first few minutes and asked for more because I 'ran out'). You just had a baby, that shit hurts yo! If you have a c-section you do not want regular underwear rubbing that incession and if you birth vag you will be putting ice packs down there. The sergical panties are the best.

I also suggest pushing away visitors the first few days your home. You are EXTREMELY tired, hurting, hormonal, and YOU want to hold the baby 24/7 - not pass it to others.

Make sure you have some type of chair or rocket for the baby. You have to set the kiddo down at some point and won't want it to always be the crib/bassinet. I suggest something that is portable so when you go to the bathroom you can bring the baby with you.

Burp cloths/ rags. I wouldn't bother getting the cutsie three pack. Opt for a twelve pack of store brand cloth diapers. They are sturdier, cheaper, and after 14 days you won't be sad they are all junked up.
